#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const ll mod = 998244353;

ll pow_mod(ll a, ll b) {
    ll res = 1;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b & 1) res = res * a % mod;
        a = a * a % mod;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

vector<vector<ll>> mat_mul(const vector<vector<ll>>& a, const vector<vector<ll>>& b) {
    vector<vector<ll>> c(2, vector<ll>(2, 0));
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
            ll v = 0;
            for (int t = 0; t < 2; t++) {
                v = (v + a[i][t] * b[t][j]) % mod;
            }
            c[i][j] = v;
        }
    }
    return c;
}

vector<vector<ll>> mat_pow(vector<vector<ll>> a, ll e) {
    vector<vector<ll>> res = {{1, 0}, {0, 1}};
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) res = mat_mul(res, a);
        a = mat_mul(a, a);
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    
    ll n, m, L, R;
    cin >> n >> m >> L >> R;
    
    if ((n % 2 == 1) && (m % 2 == 1)) {
        ll total = (R - L + 1) % mod;
        cout << pow_mod(total, n * m) << "\n";
    } else {
        ll cnt = R - L + 1;
        if (cnt % 2 == 0) {
            ll allbutone = pow_mod(cnt % mod, n * m - 1);
            cout << allbutone * (cnt / 2) % mod << "\n";
        } else {
            ll k = cnt / 2;
            vector<vector<ll>> mat = {{k, k + 1}, {k + 1, k}};
            vector<vector<ll>> res = mat_pow(mat, n * m);
            cout << res[0][0] << "\n";
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}
